metadata.title: FinFisher / FinSpy (Gamma Group): German-made 'lawful intercept' spyware in abusive hands
metadata.frame: FinFisher/FinSpy is commercial 'lawful intercept' spyware sold by the Gamma Group (UK/Germany) to governments. Amnesty International (Sep 2020) found FinSpy targeting Egyptian civil society and revealed new Mac and Linux versions alongside Windows/Android - a marquee example of the mercenary-spyware market that also includes NSO/Pegasus and Intellexa/Predator.
metadata.grade: The product, the Amnesty 2020 findings (Egypt targeting; Mac/Linux variants), and Gamma/FinFisher's insolvency (2022) = FACT (Amnesty; Citizen Lab; press). Which specific government operator deployed it in a given case is often INFERRED from infrastructure/targeting; attribution to a named agency is graded.
metadata.honest_limits: 'Lawful intercept' is the vendors' framing; documented deployments against journalists/activists show the dual-use gap. Operator attribution (which state ran a given FinSpy campaign) is usually circumstantial (server/targeting analysis), not a confession - graded accordingly. Amnesty/Citizen Lab are advocacy+research orgs; their forensic findings are well-corroborated but they are a party.
metadata.method: Amnesty International (Sep 2020 report: FinSpy Mac/Linux, Egypt); Citizen Lab FinFisher research; EU dual-use export-control debates; German prosecutors' FinFisher case (2022 insolvency).

edges.notes: Gamma Group (Gamma International, UK/Germany; FinFisher GmbH, Munich) builds the FinFisher/FinSpy 'lawful intercept' suite - full-device implants (calls, messages, mic/camera, files) marketed to law enforcement/intelligence (fact). FinFisher GmbH filed insolvency in 2022 amid German criminal scrutiny of unlicensed exports.

Amnesty International (Sep-2020) found new FinSpy variants targeting Egyptian civil society and - for the first time publicly - revealed FinSpy for macOS and Linux (alongside Windows/Android), using multi-stage loaders + modular spying. Operator inferred as an Egyptian government client (graded).

FinSpy is a core exemplar of the mercenary/commercial-spyware market - 'lawful intercept' products sold to states and repeatedly documented against journalists, activists, and dissidents (fact of category).
NSO Group (Pegasus) is the market's most notorious member - wiring the existing NSO/Pegasus nodes into the shared commercial-spyware hub (fact).
Intellexa/Cytrox (Predator) - the third major cluster (US-sanctioned 2024) - also joins the shared hub (fact).

The recurring policy failure: spyware is dual-use (Wassenaar Arrangement cyber-tools controls; EU dual-use regulation) yet repeatedly reaches abusive governments. The gap between export licensing on paper and enforcement in practice is the through-line (interpretation grounded in the export-control record).

FinSpy anchors the 'legal spyware' branch of the malware lineage - distinct from state cyber-weapons (Equation/EternalBlue) and criminal worms (ILOVEYOU/Shai-Hulud) but sharing implant/exfiltration techniques (fact of category).
